subject.title: fix(usage): show provider quota in usage footer

question: Should `/usage` reply footers perform a bounded provider-usage lookup during final reply delivery, or should this feature wait for cached/preloaded quota state?
rationale: The implementation is focused and proof-backed, but adding provider/auth probing to a reply-delivery path is a latency and omit-on-timeout product tradeoff that code review alone should not silently approve.

options.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
options.body: Restore the docs and land the PR if maintainers accept the 2500 ms omit-on-failure quota lookup for usage-enabled replies.

options.title: Require Cached State
options.body: Ask for the footer to use warmed or cached provider quota snapshots before merge so final reply delivery does not initiate a provider usage probe.

options.title: Keep Status Only
options.body: Close or pause this direction if inline quota visibility is not worth the reply-path latency and auth-routing tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Lookup
recommendation.body: Restore the docs and land the PR if maintainers accept the 2500 ms omit-on-failure quota lookup for usage-enabled replies.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history on provider-usage/status seams and is the best available owner for the lookup-versus-cache decision.
